Megan: Heads-up: Newbridge sent an RFI + security spreadsheet. They're asking for a concise RFI pack: capability matrix, POC scope, clarified pricing (Dedicated vs Private/on-prem HSM). They called out SSO, HSM integrations, and a low-latency SLA as potential deal stoppers. Can we get a short deliverable by EOD Wed?
Arjun: I'll draft the capability matrix + pricing tiers. Carmen can you handle HSM/KMS wording and the contract-side language? Ryan, add notes about fallback model variants and perf tuning.
Carmen: On it. Draft HSM wording (paste below) and I'll attach KMIP integration notes to the drive.
```
HSM / KMS draft wording:
- Private: supports customer-managed on-prem HSM via KMIP; Redwood supplies KMIP proxy and PKCS#11-compatible connectors for key operations.
- Dedicated: supports BYO HSM via peered VPC and strict routing controls; Redwood terminates TLS and customer retains private key material in their HSM.
- Hosted: managed KMS with envelope encryption; option for HSM-backed key material under Enterprise add-on with attestation reports.
- Audit & logging: All key lifecycle ops emit audit events; customers can stream logs to S3/ELK/CloudWatch for SIEM ingestion.
```
Devon: Proposed POC plan (3-week cadence):
- Week 0: Legal NDAs + network preflight + account provisioning
- Week 1: Infra provisioning (dedicated pool if requested) + baseline functional tests + sample prompts
- Week 2: Performance runs (latency and throughput targets, 50-200 qps), KV/prefix cache tuning, and quantized variant evaluation
- Week 3: Results review, recommendations (batching/quant/routing), and handoff doc + SOW snippet
SecurityBot: Uploaded Newbridge_Security_Q_2026.xlsx to Drives -> https://drive.redwood/internal/newbridge/RFI. Checklist + mapping added.
Arjun: Quick matrix CSV stub (will expand):
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private
SLA,99.9% standard,99.95% SLA,Customer-defined (on-prem install)
HSM,Managed KMS,Customer BYO HSM,On-prem HSM via KMIP
SSO (SAML/OIDC),Yes,Yes,Yes
Latency (typical gen),~40-80ms,~30-60ms,Depends on infra
Model pinning,No,Yes,Yes
Volume pricing,Usage-based,Reserved capacity,Enterprise license
```
Arjun: For pricing, propose two POC tiers: "Eval" (hosted credits + small burst on Dedicated) and "Pilot" (1-month Dedicated at prorated reserved rate). I'll fill numbers after Carmen confirms HSM hosting costs.
Ryan: Add technical fallback policy: Dedicated pool fallback routes to compatible quantized variant or opt-in hosted pool during degradation. Also call out KV prefix caching and result dedupe to reduce token usage on repetitive workloads.
Carmen: Contract language note: Newbridge requires EU data residency guarantees. Suggested line: "For EU customers, processing and logs remain in EU regions; Private installs operate entirely within customer network boundaries."
Megan: I'll assemble the zip: capability_matrix.csv, security_answers.docx, poc_timeline.md, sample_SOW.pdf. Uploading to the Newbridge drive and sharing with the rep in ~2 hours. @Devon can you skim the SOW before I send? :thumbsup:
Devon: Yep, will review in 20-30m.
Megan: Thanks all — ping me here or DM if anything else comes up. :eyes:
